name: Full Stack Web Development
description: Learn HTML5, CSS3, Modern JavaScript, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB to build production-grade web applications.

name: Python for Data Science & Machine Learning
description: Explore NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-Learn, and statistical analysis for real-world datasets.

name: Cloud Computing with AWS & Docker
description: Hands-on guide to containerization, EC2, S3, Lambda, microservices deployment, and CI/CD pipelines.

name: Responsive UI/UX Design Fundamentals
description: Master wireframing, color theory, accessibility (WCAG), and responsive layouts with modern CSS Grid and Flexbox.

name: Mobile App Development with Flutter
description: Build high-performance cross-platform iOS and Android apps using Dart and the Flutter framework.

name: Database Management with PostgreSQL
description: Deep dive into relational database modeling, complex SQL queries, indexing, transactions, and performance tuning.

name: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Basics
description: Understand network security principles, threat analysis, cryptography, penetration testing tools, and secure coding.

name: Modern JavaScript Deep Dive
description: Master asynchronous JavaScript, closures, promises, async/await, Fetch API, DOM manipulation, and design patterns.
